name: watermonitor-tooling
description: Lint and formatting for the whole repo (never installed on the Pi)

scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && npm run lint:py && npm run lint:cpp
scripts.lint:py: uvx ruff@0.17.0 check && uvx ruff@0.17.0 format --check
scripts.lint:cpp: uvx clang-format@23.1.3 --dry-run --Werror ESP32/main/*.cpp ESP32/main/*.h ESP32/main/*.ino ESP32/test/*.cpp ESP32/test/*.h
scripts.format: prettier --write . && eslint --fix . && uvx ruff@0.17.0 format && uvx ruff@0.17.0 check --fix && uvx clang-format@23.1.3 -i ESP32/main/*.cpp ESP32/main/*.h ESP32/main/*.ino ESP32/test/*.cpp ESP32/test/*.h
